description: Three-phase harmonic meters with split-core CTs or Rogowski coils (ACR10RH-DxxT(R)E3/E4), RS485 Modbus RTU
source: Acrel, "External Roche Coil and Switched Transformer Harmonic Meter - Installation and operation instruction" V1.5, section 7.4-7.5

sources.title: External Roche Coil and Switched Transformer Harmonic Meter - Installation and operation instruction

notes: Acrel ACR10RH-DxxT(R)E3 and E4 harmonic meters (T: split-core CT, TR: Rogowski coil). The older name ACR10R is kept in the models.
Addresses are register numbers as sent on the bus. FC03 reads, FC10 writes; 32-bit values are high word first.
Measurements and energies are on the secondary side: multiply voltages by the voltage ratio (14), currents by the current ratio (16) and powers and energies by the power ratio (18), all float32.
The clock is BCD: a register reading 0x0026 means 26.

Event records, waveform samples, alarm and transmission settings and the second tariff calendar (from 1200) are in the manual and left out here; history for September-December is not listed in the manual.
